title: Important Notice: 6th Convocation Schedule and Reporting Time
text:
It is hereby notified that the
6th Convocation
, scheduled to be held on

February 17, 2026
, will commence at

12:00 PM sharp
.

All gates will be
strictly closed
at the scheduled time, and

no entry will be permitted thereafter under any circumstances
.

All graduating students are
mandatorily required
to report at the
convocation venue by
10:00 AM positively
to facilitate smooth verification
and seating arrangements.

Students are advised to strictly adhere to the above schedule to avoid any inconvenience.
